description: Repo-scale (terraform-webapp): a new target-tracking scaling policy needs the ALB target group's deregistration_delay shortened too
prompts: Increase the ASG's `max_size` in asg.tf from 6 to 10, and add a new `aws_autoscaling_policy.cpu_target_tracking` (TargetTrackingScaling, predefined metric ASGAverageCPUUtilization, target_value 60) referencing `aws_autoscaling_group.app.name`. Because the ASG will now scale in and out much faster, the ALB target group's `deregistration_delay` in alb.tf must ALSO be reduced from the 300-second AWS default to 30 seconds or less - otherwise in-flight connections would be dropped and old instances would linger far longer than the new scaling cadence intends.

test_setup_files.check_scaling_policy.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

asg = open('asg.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert re.search(r'max_size\s*=\s*10', asg), 'max_size must be increased to 10'
assert 'aws_autoscaling_policy' in asg, 'a target-tracking aws_autoscaling_policy is missing'
assert re.search(r'autoscaling_group_name\s*=\s*aws_autoscaling_group\.app\.name', asg), (
    'the scaling policy must reference aws_autoscaling_group.app.name')

alb = open('alb.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
tg = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_lb_target_group"\s+"app"\s*\{(.*?)\n\s*health_check\s*\{', alb, re.DOTALL)
assert tg, 'aws_lb_target_group.app not found'
block = tg.group(1)
m = re.search(r'deregistration_delay\s*=\s*(\d+)', block)
assert m, (
    'aws_lb_target_group.app is missing deregistration_delay - with faster ASG scaling now in '
    'place, leaving it at the 300s AWS default cycles instances out much faster than '
    'connections actually drain')
delay = int(m.group(1))
assert delay <= 60, f'deregistration_delay {delay}s is still too slow for the new scaling cadence'

print('PASS')
